project.title: Study on microbial communities in super magnetic separation effluent treated by denitrification and anaerobic ammonium oxidation (ANAMMOX)
project.description: Based on denitrification and partial Anammox, the continuous flow AO reactor was used to treat the domestic sewage after Superconducting Magnetic Separation pretreatment. The microbial community in the process was studied, and the influence on the denitrification performance of the process was analyzed.
